description: Fixture bodies of the swept test files that differ from their pinned vendor contract, each with the vendor evidence that explains it (PRV-05). tools/wire-contract-sweep.mjs fails on any violation not listed here and on any entry no fixture produces. An entry never permits the field in production: with AMCP_WIRE_CONTRACTS=enforce such a write is refused.

exceptions.reason: Field absent from the pinned vendor request schema
exceptions.evidence: GtagConfig in the pinned Tag Manager v2 Discovery document (gtm-v2, revision 20260902) has no name property. The generic CRUD fixture of tests/measurement-writes.test.ts sends {name} to every Tag Manager noun; it is a synthetic fixture shape, not a field AMCP builds.

exceptions.reason: Field absent from the pinned vendor request schema
exceptions.evidence: As for CREATE_GTAG_CONFIG: GtagConfig (gtm-v2, revision 20260902) has no name property; the generic CRUD fixture of tests/measurement-writes.test.ts sends one.

exceptions.reason: Value absent from the pinned vendor enum
exceptions.evidence: SearchAnalyticsQueryRequest in the pinned Search Console v1 Discovery document (search-console-v1, captured 2026-09-04) lists the proto names (DATE, QUERY, PAGE, COUNTRY, DEVICE, SEARCH_APPEARANCE, HOUR). Google's public reference for searchanalytics.query, re-read 2026-10-12 (src/measurement-ledger-search-console.ts), spells the wire values in lower and camel case, which AMCP sends: the measurement ledger groups by date (dimensions ['date'], asserted by tests/measurement-ledger-providers.test.mjs). A read, never enforced.

exceptions.reason: Value absent from the pinned vendor enum
exceptions.evidence: The same document lists WEB, IMAGE, VIDEO, NEWS, DISCOVER and GOOGLE_NEWS, while its own description of the field says the default is "web", the value the measurement ledger sends (src/measurement-ledger-search-console.ts). A read, never enforced.

exceptions.reason: Value absent from the pinned vendor enum
exceptions.evidence: The same document lists DATA_STATE_UNSPECIFIED, FINAL, ALL and HOURLY_ALL, while its own description of the response metadata names the request values `all` and `hourly_all`; the measurement ledger sends "final" (asserted by tests/measurement-ledger-providers.test.mjs). A read, never enforced.

exceptions.evidence: The same document lists AUTO, BY_PROPERTY, BY_PAGE and BY_NEWS_SHOWCASE_PANEL, while its own description says the default is "auto"; Google's public reference (re-read 2026-10-12) spells "byProperty", which the measurement ledger sends and expects back as responseAggregationType (asserted by tests/measurement-ledger-providers.test.mjs). A read, never enforced.
